behavior.boot: Motor OFF; servo immediately commanded nominal center. First centering without horn/linkage.
behavior.steer_only: Explicit motor=0; motor OFF even with active steering lease.
behavior.controls: Motor and steering hold independently, both multitouch orders, release turn centers, release drive switches motor off, Center preserves only an already held motor request.
behavior.bound_scope: From browser processing release or communication loss to motor OFF and neutral command; excludes event delivery delay, up to next 20ms servo PWM period and mechanical motion. Timer interrupts must run.
behavior.failure: PWM/timer startup failure prevents control. Servo PWM failure switches motor OFF and servo signal LOW; physical centering not guaranteed.
behavior.reverse_pause: Continuous actual motor OFF before opposite polarity; not a measured mechanical stop. Rejection cancels nonce/press and returns HOLD_REARM. No pending timer action.
behavior.motor_button_conflict: STOP; all contacts including rejected/secondary contacts must release before a fresh action. No owner transfer.
behavior.steering_during_reverse: Same left/right wheel steering pulses, not inverted.
